entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker and Mardu native of Tarkir, mad and driven by Ugin's voice to seek healing for his broken world.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A Jeskai sage and keeper of the Annals of the Sage Eye who guides Sarkhan toward Ugin's tomb and is slain by Zurgo.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The long-dead spirit dragon planeswalker, enemy of Nicol Bolas, whose voice still drives Sarkhan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The ancient dragon who Sarkhan fears and who said he put Ugin where he lies.

entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: The Mardu khan, an orc who despises Sarkhan, ambushes him and kills Narset.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Sarkhan's broken home world, scarred by dragon bones and clan warfare.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan of mountaintop sages seeking enlightenment, led in spirit by Narset.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A raiding clan of Tarkir, Sarkhan's former clan, ruled by Zurgo.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan that leaves its fortresses to seek enemies on the steppe.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan that sends armies of the dishonored dead.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan whose shamans hear the spirits of the dead and the unwritten now.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: Ugin's sanctum whose fire shattered the stone relic Sarkhan carries.

entities.name: Nexus
entities.description: A point in the ravine where Ugin's bones rest, where reality constantly shifts.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: A mountain range on Tarkir leading to Ugin's tomb.

entities.name: Annals of the Sage Eye
entities.description: Records, kept by Narset, of the place where Ugin fell.

entities.name: Eye fragment
entities.description: A marked stone from the Eye of Ugin hanging from Sarkhan's staff, which dragonfire makes reveal words.

entities.name: kirin
entities.description: A fiery messenger of fate that appears to Narset.

events.summary: Sarkhan wanders the barren dunes of Tarkir, shouting at the ghost in his mind before heading to a distant peak.
events.quote: "Stay out of my mind, ghost!" he cries.

events.summary: Narset, meditating, perceives the word Heal in the runes of the Spirit Dragon and sees a kirin, deciding to journey.
events.quote: In her calm center she caught a flicker, the faintest scent of a word.

events.summary: Sarkhan meets Narset below her mountain; she touches his forehead and senses another presence with him.
events.quote: "I see…another…with you. Around you. Like an echo of a shadow."

events.summary: Narset demonstrates strength by splitting a boulder with three fingers.
events.quote: The stone split neatly, falling into halves like a hatched egg.

events.summary: Sarkhan recounts his travels since leaving Bolas's meditation realm and his flight back to Tarkir.
events.quote: Of the voice that constantly spoke to him, driving him ever onward until he fled back to Tarkir.

events.summary: Narset reveals Ugin is dead and that the clans have lost their way since the dragons fell.
events.quote: "It is no lie. Ugin is dead. And with him, all his brood, the dragons.

events.summary: Sarkhan's dragonfire reveals words on the fragment: look to the past and open the door to Ugin.
events.quote: 'Look to the past and open the door to Ugin.'

events.summary: Narset offers to take Sarkhan to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon.
events.quote: I can take you to the tomb of the Spirit Dragon.

events.summary: Narset explains the Nexus as they climb the Qal Sisma range.
events.quote: There, reality is always shifting and twisting, as though seeking a final form but never finding it.

events.summary: Zurgo ambushes Sarkhan and Narset stops his blow and breaks his fist.
events.quote: "I have you, traitor!" roared Zurgo, as he chopped with his butcher's blade.

events.summary: Narset urges Sarkhan to go on and holds Zurgo off.

events.quote: He lashed out with his sword. A gush of blood.

events.summary: Sarkhan's dragonfire opens a gate and he charges through it, leaving Zurgo and Narset's body.
events.quote: With a bellow, equal parts rage and release, Sarkhan charged into the flaring arch.
